title: fix(app-shell): Studio on a smaller or resized window (objectui#11795)
body:
Fixes #11795
Clause-②: no

Studio stays a desktop tool (triage direction `6043019702`): the flow canvas fits to view on resize, below the width where the inspector overlaps the canvas it opens as a drawer, and a phone gets a one-line hint. All of it is `@object-ui/app-shell`'s Studio layout and flow canvas; no contract, export or published language pack changes.

## What changed

1. **The flow canvas re-fits when its own width changes** (`FlowCanvas.tsx`). A `ResizeObserver` on the canvas viewport re-frames the diagram when the viewport's width differs from the width it was last framed at: centred, zoomed out only as far as the whole flow needs, never past 100% (the scale a flow opens at, so a 3-node flow is not zoomed up to 145% by a wider window). The mount centering is untouched.
   - **Width only, never height.** The size changes an edit causes are vertical: a held-edit notice or a refused-save strip landing above the canvas after an autosave, a Problems list growing under it below `lg`. Re-fitting on those would move the viewport right after a node edit, which the mount centering's comment forbids. A window resize, the chat dock and the side panels beside the canvas all change its width.
   - A node add, drag or edit changes the diagram, not the canvas: the observer is re-armed at the width already framed and moves nothing. A 0 width (hidden canvas) is skipped.
2. **On a narrow Automations row the Configuration aside opens as a drawer** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` AutomationsPillar layout, `wideViewport.ts`). When the pillar's own row is narrower than `AUTOMATIONS_CONFIG_FOLD_WIDTH`, the fixed 288px aside is not rendered at all (it no longer reserves its width), and a selection opens the same configuration body in the shared `Sheet` over the canvas. Closing the drawer clears the selection, as the aside's ✕ does. Wider rows keep the aside exactly as before. The row is measured with `useIsNarrowerThan` (a `ResizeObserver` on the row, read before paint); a row that measures 0 is unmeasured and keeps the aside.
3. **A one-line desktop hint on a phone** (`StudioDesignSurface` header). Below `md` (`useIsMobile`), one `role="note"` line under the Studio header reads `engine.studio.desktopHint`: "Studio is built for a desktop screen." / "Studio 专为桌面屏幕设计。" New en and zh rows in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` under the existing `engine.studio.` prefix.

## The threshold, from measurement

The overlap is decided by the pillar's own row, not by the window: the Studio chat dock sits outside that row and takes 340 to 420px of the window when it is open. One window width therefore answers both ways (1024px: canvas about 460px with no dock, about 40px with it), which a viewport breakpoint cannot express.

`AUTOMATIONS_CONFIG_FOLD_WIDTH` = flow rail 208 (`w-52`) + chrome between the row and the canvas viewport 68 (main `p-4`, framed card `p-4` and borders; read in Chromium) + aside 288 (`w-72`) + one flow column at 100% (`NODE_W` + 2 x `PADDING` = 296, the width a linear flow draws at) = 860. Below it the aside leaves less than one flow column. Every row below `md` is narrower than 860, so a phone always folds.

## Browser readings, before and after (Chromium 141, the Automations pillar)

The real `AutomationsPillar` with the real registered `FlowPreview` and `FlowInspector`, served by the console's Vite from this worktree, over a fetch stub that answers one 3-node flow (start, assignment, end). "dock" is a 420px column beside the pillar, the chat dock's default width. The harness files were temporary and are not in this PR.

| window | before: canvas width / aside | after: canvas width / aside |
|---|---|---|
| 390 | 34px beside the 288px aside; Start card off both edges | 322px, no aside; Start card inside |
| 1024 | 460px / aside | 460px / aside (row 1024, unchanged) |
| 1024 + dock | 40px / aside | 328px / drawer (row 604) |
| 1440 | 876px / aside | 876px / aside (unchanged) |
| 1440 + dock | 456px / aside | 456px / aside (row 1020, unchanged) |
| opened at 390, widened to 1024 | Start/End cards clipped at the left edge (103px off-canvas) | centred, 110px clear on each side |
| then widened to 1440 | still 103px off-canvas | centred, 318px clear on each side |
| 390, select Start | inspector squeezed into the aside beside a 34px canvas | the inspector in a 390px drawer |

Controls, after: at 1440 a node added through the toolbar palette left the diagram's translate and scale unchanged; a node select did not move the viewport. Toggling the Variables panel at 1440 narrowed the canvas from 876 to 636px and re-fitted it, centred at 100%; at 390 the same panel stacks below the canvas (a height change) and nothing moved.

## Mechanism hypotheses, as measured

1. Canvas: confirmed mount-only. Both test environments (`dom`, `dom-heavy`) install a no-op `ResizeObserver` polyfill (`vitest.setup.base.ts`); the pins replace it with a double whose notifications they deliver and put the original back, the shape `ChartContainerImpl.settleRemount.test.tsx` uses. The claim said "viewport size changes"; this re-fits on width only, for the reason above.
2. Fold: the hypothesis that the fold decision governs Automations is false. `showFoldedTabs` and `useIsWideViewport` belong to the Interfaces pillar; Automations renders its own fixed `w-72` aside at every width, independent of them. Which pillars use which layout:
   - Interfaces, the console's default (no `aiSlot`): below `xl` the inspector is a center tab, from `xl` it sits beside the canvas. No overlap, so its fold decision and its rail are not edited here.
   - Automations: the fixed aside, the measured overlap. Changed here.
   - Data: its field aside renders only while a field is selected (see the notes below).
   - Access: no right aside.
3. Hint: `t()` from `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` with the `engine.studio.` prefix; `check:i18n-designer-parity` green.
4. Pillar bar: not the same layout fix (see the notes below), so not widened.

## Pins

- `FlowCanvas.resizeFit-11795.test.tsx`: opened narrow then widened, the diagram is framed for the new width; narrowed below the diagram, it zooms out until the whole flow fits; a wider canvas does not zoom past 100%. Controls: a node add (with the re-armed observer's notification at the same width), a height-only change and a 0-wide canvas each leave the view exactly as it was.
- `AutomationsPillar.narrowRow-11795.test.tsx`: one pixel under the threshold, no aside in the row, and a node click opens the configuration in a dialog named Configuration with an enabled Label field; Escape closes it and clears the selection; a row resized from 1200 to 600 folds its aside in place. Controls: at the threshold and unmeasured (0), the aside stays and the click fills it, with no dialog.
- `StudioDesignSurface.desktopHint-11795.test.tsx`: at 390 the hint renders once, as a note, directly under the header; at 768 it does not.

## Reverse verification (each through `ablation-replace`, committed tree, restore proven)

- Resize hook: `observer.observe(vp);` replaced so the observer never observes. Blob `d42d997b917a` to `42476ad28aec`; the resize file read `Tests  3 failed | 3 passed (6)`, the three re-fit pins red and the three controls green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`d42d997b917a`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Fold: `useIsNarrowerThan(layoutRowRef, AUTOMATIONS_CONFIG_FOLD_WIDTH)` replaced with a 0 threshold. The pillar file read `Tests  3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, the three narrow-row pins red and the two controls green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`ff0517aa737d`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Local verification (HEAD `54dc0e51a`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`: `Test Files  1206 passed | 1 skipped (1207)`, `Tests  11715 passed | 9 skipped (11724)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, after building the dependency closure): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all three new test files.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the seven touched files: 0 errors; the 15 warnings all sit on lines this diff does not add.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:doc-types`, and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` / `-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite`: all exit 0.
- Entry type graph: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`, neither `dist/index.d.ts` nor `dist/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` names `wideViewport`, `useIsNarrowerThan` or `AUTOMATIONS_CONFIG_FOLD_WIDTH`; the only added exports are in `wideViewport.ts`, which the entry does not reach. Hence `Clause-②: no` and a `patch` changeset.

**After the merge, on `28566ca79`:**
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.
- The narrowed run (`studio-design/`, `metadata-admin/previews/`, `metadata-admin/__tests__/` and the objectui#11939 entry pin): `Test Files 278 passed (278)`, `Tests 2612 passed (2612)`.
- The light gates exit 0.
- CI: 43 runs, 40 success and 3 skipped. CI ran the whole suite in eight test shards, all green.

## Acceptance notes

- **objectui#11982 has landed** as `4babf4035`, and this branch merged it (`28566ca79`). `Bundle Analysis` on `28566ca79` passes: the eager closure is 3160.1 KB gzip (289 chunks) against a 3204.6 KB budget, and the main entry chunk is 71.6 KB of 350 KB. The first-load cost here is in the lazily loaded Studio chunk (`StudioRoute` loads `StudioDesignSurface` with `lazy()`), plus `wideViewport.ts` now importing two constants from the dependency-free `flow-canvas-layout.ts`.
- **Pillar bar at 390px** still scrolls sideways. The Studio header's `overflow-x-auto` is deliberate (its comment: every pillar and Publish stay reachable), so a phone header is its own change, not this layout fix. Noted, not filed (no carrier).
- **Data pillar** (source reading, not measured in a browser): its field aside (`w-80`) renders only while a field is selected, and at a phone width it would take most of the row. Same family as this card. Noted, not filed (no carrier).
- **Interfaces with an injected `aiSlot`** (the cloud seam) keeps its classic three-zone layout with a fixed aside at every width; the comment there says the cloud edition migrates on its own schedule. Noted, not filed.
- **Docs**: `packages/app-shell/README.md` (the flow canvas "Navigate" line) and `content/docs/guide/console.md` (the Studio feature table) are outside the claim's file surface, so neither is edited here.
- Copy is not pinned in any test beyond resolving the key through `t()`.
